arms.conservative: current_canonical_start_dispatch_only; shared SUP retains valid views
arms.fullcall: RevTrace conditional-tail dispatch and complete-input EL with original AU and SUP
arms.safe_versioned: strict birth-root generation retention control; name safe_versioned_birth_root; every selected install fences older complete-call jobs including ready results; shared SUP is independent
arms.ready_only: conditional dispatch; every selected install fences calls without an Owner-admitted complete receipt; full originals already in Owner ready bank may be selected at exact actual parent; physical completion before unread terminal receipt does not make a result ready; shared SUP is independent
arms.dependency_versioned: strong expected-parent version-DAG control; direct compatible handovers survive; a frozen ancestor mismatch permanently revokes descendants even if their complete inputs later converge; shared SUP is independent
arms.uir: safe unconditional inflight computation retention: identical fullcall dispatch and inherited complete-input classification/AU/SUP/durability; Owner never forwards cooperative C-entry skip hints; returned full results still require original actual-parent validity

ready_only_boundary: Owner-admitted validated complete full receipt BEFORE each actual canonical install; simultaneous/queued events are resolved by serial Owner dequeue order; neither worker physical model_end nor Consumer apply makes a receipt ready

event_order_contract.owner_dequeue_sequence: per Owner incarnation, incremented at each bound packet dequeue before policy processing
event_order_contract.owner_journal_sequence: per Owner incarnation, increasing diagnostic journal order
event_order_contract.policy_execution_sequence: per Owner coordinator, dispatch registration / validated complete receipt / actual canonical install; strict sequence defines same-timestamp order
event_order_contract.worker_times: model_end / worker_job_end_perf / sent_perf remain original worker fields
event_order_contract.channel_time: received_perf bound by FramedReader, retained as channel_received_perf
event_order_contract.install_time: canonical_install_order.observed_perf immediately after actual Reconciler.install; before later publication/Consumer application

uir_interpretation: UIR versus RevTrace estimates cooperative early cancellation costs/benefits. Both retain end-use input/authority/support checks. A tie never demonstrates these checks redundant. Unsafe UseAll guard removal exists only as named CPU fault-model negative control, never a live arm.
interpretation: safe_versioned is an author-built strict control, never an external Retire reproduction or all versioning schemes. ready_only tests inflight retention versus ordinary complete-result memoization under equal resources.
lifecycle: policy generations never overwrite owner epochs, session epochs, physical incarnations, frozen starts or immutable job IDs
source_guard: native_service.verify_source checks every frozen source file plus clean actual Git HEAD against external manifest; all arms must share the newly frozen actual commit
